# What it takes to build xrdp and xorgxrdp on Debian and Ubuntu.
# One package per line, then why it is needed. build/build-xrdp-pkg.sh
# installs these; ./check-deps.sh shows whether a release has them all.
#
# The packages' own run-time dependencies are not listed here: they are
# read from the built binaries (dpkg-shlibdeps), and check-deps.sh shows
# them too.

# tools
build-essential     C compiler and make
autoconf            xrdp and xorgxrdp use autotools
automake            xrdp and xorgxrdp use autotools
libtool             xrdp and xorgxrdp use autotools
pkg-config          finds the libraries below
nasm                x264's assembly
cmake               builds Opus
ninja-build         builds Opus
git                 fetches x264 (no release tarballs)
curl                downloads the sources
ca-certificates     for curl over https
gnupg               checks the xrdp and xorgxrdp signatures
xz-utils            unpacks .tar.xz sources
file                used by the packaging step
dpkg-dev            dpkg-shlibdeps, for the package dependencies

# libraries xrdp uses from the distribution
libssl-dev          TLS
libpam0g-dev        logins (PAM)
libx11-dev          xrdp-chansrv: clipboard and the X session
libxfixes-dev       xrdp-chansrv: clipboard
libxrandr-dev       xrdp-chansrv: screen layout
libjpeg-dev         JPEG codec
libfuse3-dev        file copy and drive redirection
libpixman-1-dev     faster screen updates
libfreetype-dev     fonts on the login screen
libimlib2-dev       images on the login screen

# xorgxrdp
xserver-xorg-dev    the Xorg server xorgxrdp is a driver for

# the Wayland sessions (the wlup module: sway, GNOME through Mutter's remote
# desktop API, KDE through KWin's protocols) and AV1
libwayland-dev          wlup: Wayland client
wayland-protocols       wlup: protocol definitions
libxkbcommon-dev        wlup: keyboard layouts
libxkbfile-dev          keyboard rules (configure checks it on devel)
libsystemd-dev          wlup GNOME backend: the session's bus
libpipewire-0.3-dev     wlup GNOME backend: screen capture
libei-dev               wlup GNOME backend: input (Mutter's ConnectToEIS)
libaom-dev              AV1 encoder (FreeRDP's GFX AV1 extension)
plasma-wayland-protocols wlup KDE backend: KWin's protocol files (1.21 and newer; older: no-kde)
